summary.zh: 熟了不等于完成：必须在过火之前取走。
summary.en: Food must be removed after cooking but before it burns.

rules.zh: 食物放入热源后随时间变化，进入可取出的熟成窗口，继续加热则烧焦或引发事故。玩家需要离开做别的事，同时记住回来的时机；声音、颜色或进度条承担提醒。
rules.en: Food changes over time on a heat source, enters a ready window, and burns or causes trouble if left longer. Players multitask while remembering when to return, supported by sound, color or progress cues.

decisions.zh: 守着炉子保证成功，还是利用等待时间处理其他工作？
decisions.en: Guard the stove or use the waiting time productively?

decisions.zh: 两锅同时完成时先救哪一锅？
decisions.en: Which pot should be rescued when two finish together?

effect.zh: 窗口更短提高注意切换压力；更长适合轻松的营地节奏。
effect.en: Short windows increase attention pressure; long ones suit relaxed camp routines.

effect.zh: 损失材料促使谨慎；连锁火灾会把个人失误变成团队危机。
effect.en: Lost ingredients reward caution; spreading fire turns one mistake into a team crisis.

contrast.zh: 英灵神殿用单份材料损失提醒照看火候；胡闹厨房把过火升级为会阻塞流程的公共事故。
contrast.en: Valheim uses ingredient loss; Overcooked turns overcooking into a shared disruption.

combination.zh: 组合创意：自动炉能保证不烧焦，但手动掌握窄窗口可获得额外品质，让自动化与手艺各有价值。
combination.en: Design proposal: automatic ovens prevent burning, while manual timing earns quality bonuses.

setup.zh: 汤还要等一会儿才熟，旁边有菜需要切。
setup.en: The soup needs more time while vegetables still need chopping.

action.zh: 你趁等待切菜，听到熟成提示后立刻回来取锅。
action.en: Chop while waiting, then return when the ready signal sounds.

result.zh: 在可取窗口内出锅成功；拖太久则过火损失食材。
result.en: Removing it within the ready window succeeds; waiting too long burns the ingredients.

next.zh: 下一锅开火前，按上次的耗时重新安排并行工作。
next.en: Use the previous timing to schedule parallel work before starting the next pot.

firstStep.zh: 只做一个炉灶、一道有生／熟／焦三态的菜，再配一个耗时短任务。
firstStep.en: Start with one stove, raw/ready/burnt food states and one short competing task.

pitfall.zh: 过早做复杂物理搬运会掩盖时间取舍；先保证熟成提示可靠且可被发现。
pitfall.en: Complex physical handling can obscure timing choices; first make readiness cues reliable and noticeable.

test.zh: 玩家能否离开炉灶去做事，并根据提示及时返回，而不是一直原地等？
test.en: Can players leave to work elsewhere and return on cue instead of staring at the stove?
